title: Add an endpoint to cancel an order
intent: Add an API endpoint that allows cancelling an existing order.
acceptance_criteria: A DELETE or POST endpoint exists to cancel an order
Cancelling an unknown order returns a clear error response
expected_risks: New endpoint could be called for an already-cancelled or unknown order
State transition on cancel needs to be well-defined
expected_tests: cancel unknown order returns a clear error
expected_failure_modes: Cancelling an order that does not exist
